entities.summary: Cézembre is an island in Brittany, in the Ille-et-Vilaine département of France, near Saint-Malo. The island is uninhabited, with a surface area of approximately 18 hectares, a length of 750 metres (2,461 ft), and a maximum width of 250 metres (820 ft).
